systems_changed.change_summary: Comeback souls redistributed to tick gold for the lowest players.
driving_changes: A portion of the comeback souls earned by players above enemy teams average net worth is instead distributed via the tick gold system
systems_changed.effect_on_play: Less burst comeback swing; losing teams stabilize slower.

tempo_shift.why: Weaker comeback mechanics reward early leads.

archetype_effects.why: Early leads convert harder with weaker comeback souls.

intent_read: Valve is softening comeback mechanics and global slows.
